states.name: application completed
states.proposition: The application boundary established ApplicationCompletion for one operation.

states.name: application ready
states.proposition: The application service accepts new execution work.

states.name: application unavailable
states.proposition: The application service cannot accept new execution work.

states.name: cancellation requested
states.proposition: A valid cancellation control signal targets the exact active RequestKey or WorkId.

states.name: client consumed output
states.proposition: An external client consumed, displayed, or acted on an output.

states.name: connection closed
states.proposition: The transport connection no longer accepts protocol I/O.

states.name: connection closing
states.proposition: Connection authority is settling reads, writes, and owned output before closure.

states.name: connection open
states.proposition: The transport connection accepts reads and writes.

states.name: deadline expired
states.proposition: The exact DeadlineId reached its bound before settlement.

states.name: delivery fate known
states.proposition: DeliveryFate is established as writer success or typed writer or transport failure.

states.name: enqueued
states.proposition: One WorkId is present in an admitted scheduler queue.

states.name: execution admitted
states.proposition: Application work is permitted to enter scheduler ownership.

states.name: execution rejected
states.proposition: Application execution was refused after request registration.

states.name: message observed
states.proposition: One exact message occurrence has been delimited for protocol evaluation.

states.name: output admitted
states.proposition: Writer authority accepts one OutputId into its causally ordered output stream.

states.name: output failed
states.proposition: The writer or transport cannot complete one admitted OutputId.

states.name: output flush committed
states.proposition: The writer confirms required buffered bytes were flushed for one OutputId.

states.name: output prepared
states.proposition: A committed publication has been projected into one OutputId before writer admission.

states.name: output write committed
states.proposition: All bytes for one OutputId were committed by the writer boundary.

states.name: owner cleaned
states.proposition: Every request-owned reservation, registration, work, publication, output, deadline, progress, and task obligation has reached known settlement or release.

states.name: protocol exited
states.proposition: The protocol lifecycle reached its terminal exit state.

states.name: protocol initialized
states.proposition: The protocol initialize transition committed for the session.

states.name: protocol shutdown requested
states.proposition: A valid protocol shutdown request committed at lifecycle authority.

states.name: protocol uninitialized
states.proposition: The session has not completed the protocol initialize transition.

states.name: protocol valid
states.proposition: The observed message satisfies the supported JSON-RPC envelope and message-shape contract.

states.name: causal publication committed
states.proposition: A current terminal decision is committed to publication order and owns one PublicationId.

states.name: request registered
states.proposition: One canonical request entry and terminal obligation exist for the exact RequestKey.

states.name: request tracking reserved
states.proposition: Capacity and duplicate-key protection are reserved for the exact RequestKey.

states.name: running
states.proposition: One WorkId is actively executing application work.

states.name: stale publication rejected
states.proposition: An application result exists but currentness authority rejects its publication attempt.

states.name: task group settled
states.proposition: Every task owned by the relevant request or session is joined, cancelled, or failed with known fate.

states.name: terminal selected
states.proposition: TerminalDecision has selected one exactly-once request cause.
